summary:
exxperts is a local desktop/web app where you work with AI in "rooms" that each keep their own memory. I saved 5 views, and each one replayed with a similarity of 1.00:
1) rooms (/): the launcher, with room cards showing memory status, Resume/Maintain buttons and the model, plus a New room tile.
2) room-chat (/#/room/helvetia-crm-migration): an open conversation with formatted AI replies, a banner asking you to choose a folder, and the message box with the memory and model controls.
3) memory-room-detail (/#/memory, then expand Helvetia and click Full memory): memory overview cards, with one room expanded to show memory growth, its topics and the full read-only notes.
4) wallet (/#/dashboard): the usage and cost dashboard, with summary cards, filters, a chart of daily spend and a weekday-by-hour activity heatmap.
5) settings-ai-setup (Settings button → Settings menu item): the settings dialog with its section list, open on AI setup (default models and providers).
I skipped two screens. The Maintain page (/#/maintain/<room>) only shows two cards, Memorize and Review, each with a Start button. The "Ask your rooms" tab is part of the Memory area. I did not start Memorize or Review because both would change data.
